"'''Nobot'''," also known as "'''Ghost Droid'''," was a [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|3PO-series protocol droid]] that constantly walked the streets of [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] wandered aimlessly across the [[Desert/Legends|deserts]] of Tatooine, and the only thing truly known about it was that it was a resilient unit&mdash;despite its travels, it would always find its way back to Mos Espa. The droid became the subject of several tales and anecdotes, most notably from the aging marketplace vendor [[Jira/Legends|Jira]].

For two [[Peggat/Legends|peggats]], the old vendor would tell her story. Jira claimed that Nobot had witnessed the [[Death/Legends|murder]] of a [[Unidentified pregnant woman|young pregnant woman]], while some believed the 3PO unit was the killer. Apparently, Nobot would play an audio recording of the incident, featuring the young woman pleading for her life and screaming in horror as the deed was done.

Beyond that, rumors persisted, claiming that the droid was surrounded by evil spirits or the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]. Repeated attempts to destroy Nobot failed, sometimes with unexplained adverse effects for the droid's antagonists. Jira's fellow vendors, listening to her repeated tellings of the story, would eventually develop their own versions while trying to compete with her.

==Biography==
===Life on Tatooine===
Originally manufactured by [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica]], the [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|3PO-series protocol droid]] known as "Nobot" or "Ghost Droid" wandered aimlessly around [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]],<ref name="db" /> a [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="tpm">{{Film|I}}</ref> It would wander across Tatooine's searing sands, and in spite of the relentless heat or avaricious [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]], Nobot would always find its way back to Mos Espa. The burned-out [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was subject to many stories, anecdotes, and rumors.<ref name="db" />

===Alleged murder witness===
[[File:NobotTPM.png|thumb|left|150px|Nobot walking in Mos Eisley]]
At a rate of two [[Peggat/Legends|peggats]] per telling, Mos Espa marketplace vendor [[Jira/Legends|Jira]] would tell her version of Nobot's tale. According to her, Nobot had been the only surviving witness to the [[Death/Legends|murder]] of a [[Unidentified pregnant woman|young pregnant woman]]. Apparently, Nobot had initially been seen in Mos Espa [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] ago, bearing scorch marks from [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] [[Laser/Legends|fire]] and covered in dried [[Blood/Legends|blood]].<ref name="db" />

In addition to that, Nobot's serial number had been scored off, preventing identification of the unit. Its communications module was apparently known to play back a recording of the murder, with audio of the victim screaming and pleading for help. A long period of static would follow the recording, before Nobot would repeat the whole thing.<ref name="db" />

===Other stories and encounters with a "Ghost Droid"===
Some believed the 3PO unit was the murderer for the event in Jira's tale. More incredible rumors claimed that Nobot was surrounded by evil spirits or the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]. [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raider]] youths who attempted to use the unit for target practice would, for instance, find their [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]] either backfiring or jamming. [[Swoop gang/Legends|Swoop gangs]] would try and destroy Nobot with hooks and chains, only to have their vehicles' engines malfunction, or have their steering vanes shorn off. [[Farmer/Legends|Farmboys]] attempted to take the droid out to the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]] or the [[Great Pit of Carkoon/Legends|Great Pit of Carkoon]], but would later learn that the droid had found its way back to Mos Espa.<ref name="db" />

Some who heard Jira's tale, such as fellow vendors, effectively stole the story and made their own modifications, adding fanciful enhancements. Then, they would sell ''their'' version, competing with Jira.<ref name="db" /> As of [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], which includes Nobot's onscreen presence, to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> the droid was still wandering, devoid of purpose.<ref name="tpm" />

==Characteristics==
[[File:Scorched3po.jpg|thumb|180px|right|Nobot was a mystery in Mos Espa.]]
Although the lack of knowledge of Nobot's purpose and origins caused rampant speculation, one thing was known: that it was persistent. The droid would frequently return and roam around Mos Espa, in spite of any adversity faced. The mysterious nature of Nobot, from the perspective of Mos Espa's citizens, created a wide range of beliefs, theories, and ultimately, profits in the form of Jira's (and others') tale-telling. Nobot had [[Color/Legends|gray]] [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] and silver plating that was charred black, and stood 1.67 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall.<ref name="db" />

==Behind the scenes==
The character of Nobot first appeared as an unnamed background droid in [[George Lucas]]' [[1999]] [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']].<ref name="tpm" /> It was later pictured in [[2005]]'s reference book ''[[Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels]]'', authored by [[Stephen J. Sansweet]] and [[Pablo Hidalgo]], with the droid's picture included as part of the entry for [[TC-series protocol droid/Legends|TC-series protocol droids]], implying it being that droid class.<ref name="SWCTP">''[[Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels]]''</ref> Nobot was given a nickname and an ambiguous story by [[Shaun Flaherty]] (writing as "Jedi Flaherty") through [[StarWars.com]]'s [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] feature "[[What's The Story?]]" Contrary to ''Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels'', Nobot was identified as a 3PO-series protocol droid instead of a TC-series protocol droid in that entry.<ref name="Hyperspace">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/photoreceptor/2003/07/photoreceptor20030725.html|series=Photoreceptor|text=Protocol Potable}}</ref> This article assumes that Nobot's identification as a 3PO-series protocol droid is correct.
